regions.merged_text: The "bottle in the corner" you asked about is water from Lourdes. Use it in case of sickness, etc. It was sent me from the Shrine directly. . Do not worry about missing this or what piece of junk in Cell #5. I've often figured on how to rid myself of the whole collection.
